name: microsoft-graph_dev
label: Microsoft Graph API (fork)
description: Microsoft Graph API is a powerful and unified programming interface provided by Microsoft that allows developers to access a wide range of data and services from Microsoft 365 and Azure Active Directory (Azure AD). It provides a single endpoint and a consistent set of RESTful web APIs, making it easier for developers to integrate and interact with Microsoft's cloud services and applications.

operations.title: Get All Security Alerts
operations.description: Retrieves a list of alerts from the Microsoft Graph API based on the input parameters you have specified.

parameters.title: API Version
parameters.name: api_version
parameters.tooltip: Select the version of the API you want to use for retrieving security alerts. If the user selects V2, it provides comprehensive information and detailed context about alerts, where as V1 refers to the older version of the alerts API. By default,V1 is selected.

V1.title: Vendor
V1.description: Specify the name of the product vendor that provided the alert you want to retrieve using the Microsoft Graph API. For example, Microsoft.
V1.name: vendor
V1.tooltip: Specify the name of the product vendor that provided the alert you want to retrieve using the Microsoft Graph API. For example, Microsoft.

V1.title: Provider
V1.description: Specify the security product that provided the alert you want to retrieve using the Microsoft Graph API. For example, Cloud Application Security.
V1.name: provider
V1.tooltip: Specify the security product that provided the alert you want to retrieve using the Microsoft Graph API. For example, Cloud Application Security.

V1.title: Severity
V1.description: Select the alert severity, set by the vendor or provider, to retrieve alerts using the Microsoft Graph API. You can choose from the following options:  Unknown, Low, Medium, High, Informational.
V1.tooltip: Select the alert severity, set by the vendor or provider, to retrieve alerts using the Microsoft Graph API. You can choose from the following options:  Unknown, Low, Medium, High, Informational.
V1.name: severity

operations.title: Get Security Alert
operations.description: Retrieves details of a specific alert from the Microsoft Graph API based on the alert ID you have specified.

parameters.title: API Version
parameters.name: api_version
parameters.tooltip: Select the version of the API you want to use for retrieving security alerts. If the user selects V2, it provides comprehensive information and detailed context about alerts, where as V1 refers to the older version of the alerts API. By default V1 is selected.

parameters.title: Alert ID

operations.title: Add Comment on Security Alert
operations.description: Adds a comment to an existing alert based on the specified alert ID.

parameters.title: Alert ID
parameters.name: alert_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique Alert ID to which you want to add the comment. The alert ID is generated by the provider when an alert is created in Azure.

parameters.title: Comment
parameters.name: comment
parameters.tooltip: Specify the comment you want to add to the specified alert.

operations.title: Get Groups
operations.description: Retrieves a list of groups from the Microsoft Graph API.

operations.title: Get Users Within A Group
operations.description: Retrieves a list of users within a specific group from the Microsoft Graph API based on the group ID you have specified.

parameters.title: Group ID
parameters.name: group_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the group whose users you want to retrieve from Microsoft Graph. Note: To get the Group ID, use the Get Groups operation.

operations.title: Search Message in Users Mailbox
operations.description: Searches for messages in a user's mailbox within an organization based on the Subject and user list you have specified.

parameters.title: Subject
parameters.name: subject
parameters.tooltip: Specify a subject based on which you want to search for messages in Azure.

parameters.title: User List
parameters.name: user_list
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of user IDs based on which you want to search messages in Azure.

parameters.title: Page Size
parameters.name: size
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Number of messages you want to retrieve per user in this request. The default page size is 10. Page size should be between 1 to 1000.

parameters.title: Offset
parameters.name: skip
parameters.tooltip: Number of messages you want to skip for each in this request.

operations.title: Delete Message
operations.description: Deletes a specific message from the specific user's mailbox in Azure based on the user ID and message ID you have specified.

parameters.title: User ID
parameters.name: user_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the user based on which you want to delete the specific message from Azure.

parameters.title: Message ID
parameters.name: message_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the message that you want to delete from Azure.

operations.title: Delete Message Bulk
operations.description: Deletes messages from multiple users' mailboxes in Azure based on the comma-separated list of users you have specified.

parameters.title: User List
parameters.name: user_list
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of users' mailboxes, which is a list of JSON objects, based on which you want to delete bulk messages in Azure. The format of the list is as follows: [ { 'user_id':"", 'message_id':"" }, { 'user_id':"",'message_id':"" }]

operations.title: Revoke User Session
operations.description: Invalidates all the refresh tokens issued to applications for a user.

parameters.title: User ID or PrincipalName
parameters.name: user
parameters.tooltip: Specify the User ID or PrincipalName of the user whose refresh tokens you want to invalidate (revoke) from the Microsoft Graph API.

operations.title: Get All Named Locations
operations.description: Retrieves a list of named locations from Azure based on display name, sort order, and other input parameters that you have specified.

parameters.title: Display Name
parameters.name: name
parameters.tooltip: Specify the display name of the named location to retrieve from Azure.

parameters.title: Required Fields
parameters.name: select
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Select the sort order criterion to sort the results. Select the sorting order in the Sort Order field. You can choose from the following options: ID, Display Name, Created Date Time, Modified Date Time.

parameters.title: Order By
parameters.name: order_by
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Select the sort order criterion to sort the results. Select the sorting order in the Sort Order field. You can choose from the following options: ID, Display Name, Created Date Time, Modified Date Time.

ID.title: Sort Order
ID.name: order
ID.description: (Conditional - This field appears after selecting an order criterion in Order By field) Specify the sort order from the following options: Ascending, Descending By default, it retrieves named locations in ascending order.
ID.tooltip: This field appears after selecting an order criterion in Order By field) Specify the sort order from the following options: Ascending, Descending By default, it retrieves named locations in ascending order.

Display Name.title: Sort Order
Display Name.name: order
Display Name.description: (Optional) Orders the response Ascending or Descending order on specified field. By default it retrieves in ascending order.
Display Name.tooltip: Orders the response Ascending or Descending order on specified field. By default it retrieves in ascending order

Created Date Time.title: Sort Order
Created Date Time.name: order
Created Date Time.description: (Optional) Orders the response Ascending or Descending order on specified field. By default it retrieves in ascending order.
Created Date Time.tooltip: Orders the response Ascending or Descending order on specified field. By default it retrieves in ascending order

Modified Date Time.title: Sort Order
Modified Date Time.name: order
Modified Date Time.description: (Optional) Orders the response Ascending or Descending order on specified field. By default it retrieves in ascending order.
Modified Date Time.tooltip: Orders the response Ascending or Descending order on specified field. By default it retrieves in ascending order.

parameters.title: Count
parameters.name: count
parameters.tooltip: Select to retrieve the total count of named locations matched in Azure. By default, it is set to false.

parameters.title: Size
parameters.name: size
parameters.tooltip: Specify the number of named locations to retrieve in this request.

parameters.title: Offset
parameters.name: skip
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Specify the number of named locations you want to skip in this request.

operations.title: Block New IP Ranges
operations.description: Blocks IPv4 and IPv6 address ranges in the specified NamedLocation in Azure.

parameters.title: IP Named Location's UUID
parameters.name: namedLocationUuid
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique Named Location ID for which you want to block the IP addresses.

parameters.title: IPv4 Ranges
parameters.name: ipv4_ips
parameters.tooltip: Specify IP address ranges in IPv4 CIDR format (1.2.3.4/32) to be blocked in the specified named location. You can specify multiple IPv4 ranges as comma-separated values. e.g. 10.10.10.10/14, 10.10.10.10/13, 10.10.10.10/09

parameters.title: IPv6 Ranges
parameters.name: ipv6_ips
parameters.tooltip: Specify IP address ranges in allowable IPv6 format, defined in IETF RFC5962, to be blocked in the specified named location. You can specify multiple IPv6 ranges as comma-separated values. e.g. 2001:db8::/43, 2001:db8::/47

operations.title: Unblock IP Ranges
operations.description: Unblocks IPv4 and IPv6 address ranges in the specified NamedLocation in Azure.

parameters.title: IP Named Location's UUID
parameters.name: namedLocationUuid
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique named location ID for which you want to unblock the IP addresses.

parameters.title: IPv4 Ranges
parameters.name: ipv4_ips
parameters.tooltip: Specify IP address ranges in IPv4 CIDR format (1.2.3.4/32) to be unblocked in the specified named location. You can specify multiple IPv4 ranges as comma-separated values. For example: 10.10.10.10/14, 10.10.10.10/13, 10.10.10.10/09

parameters.title: IPv6 Ranges
parameters.name: ipv6_ips
parameters.tooltip: Specify IP address ranges in IPv6 format, as defined in IETF RFC5962, to be unblocked in the specified named location. You can specify multiple IPv6 ranges as comma-separated values. For example: 2001:db8::/43, 2001:db8::/47

operations.title: Create IP Named Location
operations.description: Creates a new IP named location in Azure based on the specified input parameter.

parameters.title: Display Name
parameters.name: name
parameters.tooltip: Specify the display name of the named location to create in Azure.

parameters.title: Is Trusted
parameters.name: is_trusted
parameters.tooltip: Select if the IP Range is trusted.

parameters.title: IPv4 Ranges
parameters.name: ipv4_ips
parameters.tooltip: Specify IP address ranges in IPv4 CIDR format (1.2.3.4/32) to be added in the specified named location. You can specify multiple IPv4 ranges as comma-separated values. For example: 10.10.10.10/14, 10.10.10.10/13, 10.10.10.10/09

parameters.title: IPv6 Ranges
parameters.name: ipv6_ips
parameters.tooltip: Specify IP address ranges in IPv6 format, as defined in IETF RFC5962, to be added in the specified named location. You can specify multiple IPv6 ranges as comma-separated values. For example: 2001:db8::/43, 2001:db8::/47

operations.title: Get Security Incidents
operations.description: Retrieves a list of alerts from the Microsoft Graph API based on the input parameters you have specified.

parameters.title: Top
parameters.name: top
parameters.tooltip: Specifies the maximum number of incidents to return. If omitted, Microsoft Graph returns its default page size.

parameters.title: Skip
parameters.name: skip
parameters.tooltip: Skips the first N incidents before returning results. Primarily used for pagination.

parameters.title: Filter
parameters.name: filter
parameters.tooltip: Filters incidents based on one or more properties using OData syntax. Example: status eq 'active'

parameters.title: Order By
parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.tooltip: Sorts the returned incidents by a specified property in ascending (asc) or descending (desc) order. Example: lastUpdateDateTime desc

parameters.title: Count
parameters.name: count
parameters.tooltip: Returns the total number of incidents that match the query in addition to the incident list. set it to 'true' if required.

parameters.title: Fetch Alerts
parameters.name: fetchAlerts
parameters.tooltip: If the checkbox is unchecked, alerts will not be fetched.
